entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider serves as a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval and is available as an OSS SDK, a self-hosted server, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and hybrid search combining RAG and memory. It provides automated fact extraction, user profile maintenance, and connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading. It is an open-source context database that provides observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for the Hermes Agent provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It offers Python and Node.js client SDKs and acts as an LLM wrapper for existing agents.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server and provides Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a context tree using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge operations. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI and REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system includes vector search, structured facts, fabric recall, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and runs on local infrastructure including Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for simulating and investigating tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based context engine to ensure messages are never lost. It utilizes a SQLite message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes in a DAG.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores information as plain-text YAML engrams to support multi-agent systems. It provides local-first, zero-cost search and is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It features tools for memory inspection, editing, and deletion and reports 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine uses hybrid retrieval, including BM25, vector search, and graph traversal, with no cloud dependencies. It integrates via Hermes plugins or Claude Code hooks and automates decision capture using a local GGUF observer model.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates inference by using block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, long-term memory architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family that includes a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result. It supports temporal context graphs with recency-aware ranking and includes knowledge packs for mounting signed expertise files.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by watching agent session logs. It utilizes local-first storage via SQLite-vec and node-llama-cpp and functions as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval through SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in tool-schema tokens.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only necessary context, potentially reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It renders facts into files like AGENTS.md and supports MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across various chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate automated payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It offers hybrid recall capabilities including HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, MCP servers, and skills.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes hybrid search combining vector, graph, and BM25 methods, and features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It runs on localhost and supports grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first prototyping system that supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats. It features automation, design systems, and plugin capabilities while maintaining compatibility with local CLI executables and coding agents.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers client support for Python, Rust, and TypeScript to manage ingested data.
